warning: Loading screen layout is NOT recovered: no loading-screen widget blueprint exists in the pak index (the loading screen is native Slate; checked for this build only). Only the LSID background reference, textures and tip strings are original data.
blackPanelFinding: The black left region is ORIGINAL texture data, not an export/alpha bug: FORT_Load_BattleRoyale is DXT1 (no alpha channel); every block in the region has color0==color1==RGB(0,0,0) with all indices 2 (verified in the raw DDS, `umodel -export -dds`), and there is no 1-bit punch-through. Every other loading background (FORT_Load_Missions_*, Cosmetics/FORT_Load_TestScreen) carries the same polygonal dark panel + blue plate template; the game draws its own elements over the panel natively (no widget blueprint references these textures). Icon-LoadScreen-Default and Icon-LoadScreen-FierceCloudpuff are byte-identical 168x168 locker preview images (LargePreviewImage/SmallPreviewImage), not loading-screen layers. T-Logo-Wordmark-1024x512 (white FORTNITE wordmark with alpha, DXT5) is the logo used by the frontend/login widgets; its use on the loading panel is a runtime choice.

tips.text: You can shoot at trees, rocks, and structures to destroy them.
Players hiding in a building? Knock it down.
Explosive weapons do significant damage to structures.
Need cover? Build some.
Explore quickly by building your own stairs and bridges.
As the eye of the storm shrinks, storm damage increases!
Watch out! The storm closes in as the match progresses.
Look and listen for treasure chests. They often have good weapons or items.
The majority of items & gear can be found inside buildings.
Patch yourself up with Bandages. Use Med Kits to restore full health.
Use Shield Potions to increase the total amount of damage you can take.
Shields will not protect you from falling damage, or the storm.
Open doors and looted treasure chests could mean other players are near.
Use the map to see where you are, and where the storm is headed.
You can fall to your death. So... don't.
You can sprint for as long as you'd like in Battle Royale!
Headshots do significant damage. Aim for the head!
Shotguns, SMGs, and Pistols are effective at close range.
Assault Rifles are effective at medium range.
Sniper Rifles are effective at long range.
Place traps in places where other players won’t see them.
Listen carefully! You may hear an approaching player’s footsteps.
Making too much noise can alert others to your position.
Moving while shooting will decrease weapon accuracy.
Use crouch to reduce your profile, or to hide behind smaller objects.
Doors stay open until closed. Hide your tracks by closing doors.
Finding an open door means someone else has already been there.
Inventory space is limited - choose your loadout wisely.
When your inventory is full, picking up an item will swap it with what is currently equipped.
Ammo, building resources, and traps do not take inventory space. Pick up as many as you like!
You can change which slots your items are assigned to in the inventory screen.
While skydiving, dive towards your destination to get there faster.
